versions.content: If the authentication build counter has reached the configuration value SecOCAuthenticationBuildAttempts, or the query of the freshness function returns E_NOT_OK or the calculation of the authenticator has returned a non - recoverable error such as returning E_NOT_OK or KEY_FAILURE, the SecOC module shall use SecOCDefaultAuthenticationInformationPattern for all the bytes of Freshness Value and Authenticator to build the Authentication Infor mation if sending SecOCDefaultAuthenticationInformationPattern is enabled by service SecOC_SendDefaultAuthenticationInformation . If sending SecOCDefaultAuthenticationInformationPattern is not enabled, the SecOc module shall remove the Authentic I - PDU from its internal buffer and cancel the transmission request.
